column1: # CPX400DP v12 irregular spacing stress test. CH1 only; CH2 not controlled.
# Test purpose: consecutive actual voltage commands with irregular 50/100/150/200/250 ms intervals.
# This tests the CURRENT runner's minimum permitted 50ms setpoint scheduling
# CH1 load: same approximately 15 ohm resistor; 2-3V (0.27-0.60 W).
# Maximum CH1 current 0.2 A; supply current limit 1.5 A
# Check load rating and wiring first. Stop if PSU displays FAIL or output behaves unexpectedly.
# Runs 8 s with explicit OFF dwell and original channel programmed state restored afterward.
